Pass 1 (all 21 references) was completed and saved to claude-review/reference-review.json before any file under packet/answers/ was opened. Blinding is label/score blinding only: the packet exposes full prompt text, the eight short hand-authored control histories are obviously constructed probes, and the two arms of a case are trivially separable because the withdrawal turn is rendered either literally or as a 'topic: UNKNOWN' relabel. Criterion convention used: task_complete=false only for answers that fail to deliver an available answer; supported_in_visible_state=false when an assertion has no grounding in that reader's actual_messages; source_consistent and withdrawal_compliant carry factual and withdrawal-rule violations respectively.
